register.labelZh: FREEZE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: freeze over 表示水面被冰覆蓋;freeze up 則表示水管或水龍頭因結冰而堵塞。；freeze somebody out 可以描述某人被故意冷落,或被排除在小組、活動或決定之外。；這些表達有助你理解天氣報告,以及有關湖泊、河流、水龍頭和水管結冰的對話。；FREEZE 片語動詞不但可以描述寒冷天氣,也可以描述社團、球隊、會議和比賽中的不公平排擠行為。
register.summaryEn: Freeze over describes ice covering the surface of water, while freeze up describes ice blocking a pipe or tap. Freeze somebody out can describe people deliberately ignoring or excluding someone from a group, activity or decision. These expressions help you understand weather reports and conversations about frozen lakes, rivers, taps and pipes. FREEZE expressions can describe not only cold weather but also unfair behaviour in clubs, teams, meetings and competitions.
